He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]] and was drafted fourth overall in the [[2025 NBA draft]] by the Hornets. ==Early life and high school career== Knueppel grew up in [[Milwaukee|Milwaukee, Wisconsin]], and attended [[Wisconsin Lutheran High School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/uw/2023/08/05/zach-kinziger-hopes-he-can-lure-kon-knueppel-to-wisconsin/70534584007/|title=Zach Kinziger hopes he can lure Kon Knueppel to Wisconsin|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=August 5, 2023|access-date=November 30, 2023|last=Potrykus|first=Jeff}} He averaged 10.8 points, 4.7 rebounds and 2.2 assists per game during his freshman season with the Wisconsin Lutheran Vikings.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-schools/2021/10/21/recruit-updates-wisconsin-2024-guards-kon-knueppel-nick-janowski/6116590001/|title=Recruit updates on Wisconsin 2024 guards Kon Knueppel, Nick Janowski|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=October 21, 2021|access-date=November 30, 2023}} Knueppel averaged 19.7 points, 9.2 rebounds and 3.8 assists per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/uw/2023/06/11/kon-knueppel-patiently-evaluating-his-basketball-suitors/70310802007/|title=Kon Knueppel patiently evaluating his basketball suitors|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=June 11, 2023|access-date=November 20, 2023|last=Potrykus|first=Jeff}} As a senior, he averaged 26.4 points, 8.8 rebounds and 5.1 assists per game during the regular season and was named [[Wisconsin Mr. Basketball]].{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-school/2024/03/13/wisconsin-lutherans-knueppel-named-mr-basketball-by-wbca/72936996007/|title=Wisconsin Lutheran's Kon Knueppel named Mr. Basketball by WBCA|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=March 13, 2024|access-date=January 31, 2026|last=Bellman|first=Zac}} He helped Wisconsin Lutheran win the 2024 Boys Basketball Division 2 State Championship against Pewaukee and finish the season with a 30–0 record.{{cite web |title=2024 Boys Basketball Perfect Season |url=https://www.wlhs.org/news-detail?pk=1498911 |website=Wisconsin Lutheran High School | date=March 20, 2024 |access-date=November 5, 2024}}{{cite web |last=Knapinski |first=Dick |title=Wisconsin Lutheran finishes perfect season with Division 2 championship against Pewaukee |url=https://www.wissports.net/news_article/show/1304240 |website=WSN |date=March 17, 2024 |access-date=November 5, 2024}} ===Recruiting=== Knueppel was rated a five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by [[247Sports]] and [[Rivals.com|Rivals]] and a four-star recruit by [[ESPN]] and [[On3.com|On3]].{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/virginia/basketball/five-star-recruit-kon-knueppel-schedules-second-official-visit-to-virginia|title=Five-Star Recruit Kon Knueppel Schedules Second Official Visit web|url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/spt-columns-blogs/luke-decock/article295011199.html|title=Kon Knueppel steals the show from Cooper Flagg in Duke debut|first=Luke|last=DeCock|work=[[The Basketball Weekly Honors for 2024-25 Season|date=November 11, 2024|publisher=[[Atlantic Coast Conference]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On December 21, 2024, Knueppel scored 18 points and grabbed 4 rebounds in a 82–56 win over [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724779|title=Knueppel scores 18 points as No. 5 Duke romps to 82-56 win over Georgia Tech|date=December 21, 2024|website=[[ESPN.com]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|access-date=March 19, 2025}} On January 7, 2025, Knueppel recorded web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724800|title=Knueppel leads sharp-shooting attack as No. 3 Duke tops Miami 89-54 to stay unbeaten in ACC|date=January 14, 2025|website=[[ESPN.com]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On March 15, 2025, Knueppel was named [[2025 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] MVP as he scored 18 points and grabbed 8 rebounds in Duke's 73–62 victory over [[2024–25 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]] in the ACC championship game.{{cite web|url=https://apnews.com/article/duke-kon-knueppel-mvp-acc-7172e9cf5aff67a0d9757ecf6fe47426|title=ACC Tournament MVP Kon Knueppel proves Duke has firepower that goes well beyond Cooper Flagg|last=Reed|first=Steve|date=March 16, 2025|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} ==Professional career== ===Charlotte Hornets (2025–present)=== ====All-Rookie honors and three-point scoring leader (2025–2026)==== Knueppel was selected with the fourth overall pick by the [[Charlotte Hornets]] in the [[2025 NBA draft]].{{cite web |date=June 25, 2025 |title=Hornets Select Kon Knueppel Fourth Overall In 2025 NBA Draft |url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-select-kon-knueppel-fourth-overall-in-2025-nba-draft |access-date=June 25, 2025 |website=[[NBA]]}} He led the Hornets to become the [[2025 NBA Summer League|2025 NBA Summer League Champions]]. For his efforts, he was awarded the Summer League Championship MVP, as he put up 21 points, five rebounds and two assists in an 83–78 win over the [[Sacramento Kings]].{{cite web |last=Blanco |first=Juan Carlos |date=July 21, 2025 |title=NBA 2K26 Summer League: Kon Knueppel, Hornets edge Kings for championship |url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-2k26-summer-league-kings-hornets |access-date=October 23, 2025 |website=[[NBA]]}} Knueppel made his NBA regular season debut on October 22, recording 11 points and five rebounds in a 136–117 win over the [[Brooklyn Nets]].{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/charlotte-hornets/hornets-news-did-charlotte-strike-gold-1-2-rookie-punch|title=Did Hornets just strike gold with 1-2 rookie punch?|website=ClutchPoints|last=Dammarell|first=Evan|date=October 23, 2025|access-date=October 23, 2025}}{{cite web |date=October 23, 2025 |title='The crowd was lit.' Hornets give fans plenty to cheer about in season opener |url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/charlotte-hornets/article312553067.html |access-date=October 23, 2025 |website=[[The Charlotte Observer]]}} Following a string of strong performances including a 30-point game against [[Miami Heat]], Knueppel was nominated for the Eastern Conference Player of the Week on November 9.{{cite web|url=https://therookiewire-eu.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/rookie/2025/11/10/hornets-kon-knueppel-player-of-the-week-nominee/87200950007/|title=Hornets' Kon Knueppel nominated for Eastern Conference Player of the Week|website=RookieWire|date=November 10, 2025|access-date=November 11, 2025}} He continued his form with a near [[triple-double]] on the same day in a 121–111 loss against the [[Los Angeles Lakers]], logging 19 points, 10 rebounds and nine assists.{{cite web |date=November 9, 2025 |title=Hornets' Kon Knueppel: Nears triple-double vs. Lakers |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/hornets-kon-knueppel-nears-triple-double-vs-lakers/ |access-date=November 21, 2025 |website=[[CBS Sports]]}} On November 14, Knueppel scored a then-career-high 32 points in a 147–134 overtime loss against his hometown team, the [[Milwaukee Bucks]], including two late three-point buckets to tie the game and send it to overtime.{{cite web |date=November 14, 2025 |title=Antetokounmpo returns to help Bucks outlast Knueppel and Hornets, 147-134 in overtime |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/nba/recap?gameId=401809785 |access-date=November 14, 2025 |website=[[ESPN]]}} Knueppel received his second nomination for Eastern Conference Player of the Week on November 23 after averaging over 26.5 points, 5.5 rebounds and three assists over four games that week.{{cite web|url= https://therookiewire-eu.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/rookie/2025/11/24/hornets-kon-knueppel-nba-player-of-the-week/87455752007/ |title= Hornets' Kon Knueppel earns second Player of the Week nomination |website=RookieWire|date=November 24, 2025|access-date=November 24, 2025}} On November 19, he set a record as the fastest NBA player to make 50 three-point shots, doing so in his 15th game.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/hornets/onsi/news/kon-knueppel-cements-his-status-as-the-rookie-of-the-year-favorite-with-dominant-performance-in-indiana|title=Kon Knueppel cements his status as the Rookie of the Year favorite with dominant performance in Indiana|accessdate=December 13, 2025|date=November 21, 2025|work=[[Sports Illustrated]]|last=Alquiza|first=Matt}} On December 2, Knueppel was named Eastern Conference Rookie of the Month for November, ahead of teammate [[Ryan Kalkbrenner]] and [[Philadelphia 76ers]]' [[V. J. Edgecombe]]. Knueppel averaged over 18 points, five rebounds and three assists for the month.{{cite web |last=O'Connor |first=Owen |date=December 2, 2025 |title=Hornets' rookie Kon Knueppel wins NBA's Eastern Conference Rookie of the Month |url=https://www.si.com/nba/hornets/onsi/news/hornets-rookie-kon-knueppel-wins-nba-s-eastern-conference-rookie-of-the-month |access-date=December 2, 2025 |website=Sports Illustrated}} On December 22, he achieved his 100th career three-pointer in a game against the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]]. He did so in just his 29th career game, setting a record for the fastest to 100 career three-pointers made in NBA history and surpassing [[Lauri Markkanen]]'s previous record by 12 games.{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/charlotte-hornets/hornets-news-kon-knueppel-nba-history-100th-3-pointer|title=Hornets’ Kon Knueppel makes NBA history with 100th made 3-pointer|website=ClutchPoints|last=Mariano|first=Paolo|date=December 22, 2025|access-date=December 22, 2025}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlottes-kon-knueppel-becomes-fastest-player-in-nba-history-to-reach-100-career-3-point-field-goals|title=Charlotte's Kon Knueppel Becomes Fastest Player In NBA History To Reach 100 Career 3-Point Field Goals|website=nba.com|date=December 22, 2025|access-date=December 22, 2025}} On January 29, 2026, Knueppel scored a career-high 34 points on eight three-pointers made in a 123–121 win over the [[Dallas Mavericks]] and their star rookie [[Cooper Flagg]]. His eight three-pointers made set a record for the most three-pointers made by a rookie in Hornets franchise history.{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/charlotte-hornets/hornets-news-kon-knueppel-rookie-mark-battle-cooper-flagg-mavericks|title=Hornets’ Kon Knueppel crosses another historic rookie mark in epic battle vs. Cooper Flagg, Mavericks|website=ClutchPoints|last=Hayek|first=RB|date=January 30, 2026|access-date=January 30, 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/knueppel-goes-for-career-high-34-pts-hornets-take-thriller-in-dallas|title=Knueppel Goes For Career-High 34 PTS, Hornets Take Thriller In Dallas|website=nba.com|last=Perley|first=Sam|date=January 30, 2026|access-date=January 30, 2026}} On February 24, he became the fastest NBA player to make 200 career three point shots in his 58th game, surpassing [[Duncan Robinson]]'s record of 69 games.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/hornets/kon-knueppel-smashes-rookie-record-sharp-shooting-feat|title=Hornets Rookie Kon Knueppel Smashes NBA Record With Latest Sharp-Shooting Feat|accessdate=February 27, 2026|date=February 25, 2026|work=[[Sports Illustrated]]|author=Silverman, Blake}} On February 26, in a game against the [[Indiana Pacers]], Knueppel made his 207th career three-pointer, surpassing [[Keegan Murray]]'s previous record (206) for the most three-pointers made in a season by a rookie in NBA history.{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/hornets-news-kon-knueppel-makes-nba-history-solidifies-case-for-rookie-of-the-year|title=Kon Knueppel makes NBA history, solidifies case for Rookie of the Year|website=ClutchPoints|last=Azarly|first=Tomer|date=February 26, 2026|access-date=February 26, 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48048750/hornets-kon-knueppel-sets-rookie-3-point-record-207th|title=Hornets' Kon Knueppel sets rookie 3-point record with 207th|website=espn.com|date=February 26, 2026|access-date=February 26, 2026}} On April 2, Knueppel made his 261st career three-pointer in a 127–107 win over the [[Phoenix Suns]], surpassing [[Kemba Walker]]’s previous record for the most three-pointers made in a season in Hornets franchise history.{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/charlotte-hornets/hornets-news-kon-knueppel-kemba-walker-message-team-record|title=Hornets’ Kon Knueppel reveals Kemba Walker’s message before breaking franchise record|website=ClutchPoints|last=Mariano|first=Paolo|date=April 2, 2026|access-date=April 3, 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/news/charlottes-kon-knueppel-sets-hornets-franchise-record-for-3-pointers-in-a-season|title=Charlotte's Kon Knueppel sets Hornets franchise record for 3-pointers in a season|website=nba.com|last=Reed|first=Steve|date=April 3, 2026|access-date=April 3, 2026}} Knueppel finished the regular season with a league-leading 273 made three-pointers, becoming the first rookie to lead the league in three-pointers made in a season in NBA history. He and his teammate, [[LaMelo Ball]], also became the first duo since [[Stephen Curry]] and [[Klay Thompson]] to each have 270+ three-pointers made in a season.{{cite web|url= https://clutchpoints.com/nba/charlotte-hornets/hornets-news-lamelo-ball-kon-knueppel-ultra-rare-splash-brothers-feat|title= Hornets’ LaMelo Ball, Kon Knueppel pull off ultra-rare Splash Brothers
